posts.title: New Willy Wonka reality show
posts.description: Netflix is using an AI-generated Gene Wilder voice in its Willy Wonka reality show. As a Dahl expert—and living human being with eyes and ears and a brain—I hate every single thing about this. Also, it doesn’t even sound like him. Wilder’s and Dahl’s heirs should be ashamed.

posts.title: How Quentin Blake draws
posts.description: Quentin Blake’s website has a page of information about how he draws, as well as some videos of him in action. I especially liked this one of him drawing a hornswoggler!

posts.title: Dahl items at auction this week
posts.description: I’ve had a couple people reach out to alert me to this news: Roald Dahl’s original sketches to be auctioned. These are drawings that Dahl himself made prior to publication of his memoir Boy – Tales of Childhood.
